name: Currant Fritters

ingredients.name: dry, fine bread crumbs

ingredients.name: One-half pound currants, washed and well dried

instructions.text: Boil the milk and pour over the bread
Mix and put in the butter
Beat in the yolks and sugar, the seasoning, and flour
Finally, add the currants dredged lightly with flour
Drop in great spoonfuls into hot lard and fry
Drain them and send hot to table
Eat with a mixture of wine and powdered sugar

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil the milk and pour over the bread
2. Mix and put in the butter
3. Let it get cold
4. Beat in the yolks and sugar, the seasoning, and flour
5. Beat in stiff whites
6. Finally, add the currants dredged lightly with flour
7. Drop in great spoonfuls into hot lard and fry
8. Drain them and send hot to table
9. Eat with a mixture of wine and powdered sugar
